_README: Job boards built on Bubble that leave their Data API open, and how to read each one.
Add a host by probing https://<host>/api/1.1/obj/<type> — see references/sourcing.md.
Every key except `host` and `type` is optional; fields absent from a board are left empty
rather than guessed, because an invented location is worse than no location.

boards.title: Name
boards.note: A recruiting agency's board: it fronts for client companies, so `org` is the agency and the employer is described but not named. No location field exists at all — geography lives in the description only.
